description: This is a Python source file for a module that facilitates the transformation and handling of audio transcription requests and responses between OpenAI's API and Deepgram's API. It defines a configuration class for Deepgram audio transcription, including methods to process audio files, transform responses, build request URLs, and validate environment credentials.

classes.name: DeepgramAudioTranscriptionConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Deepgram audio transcription that extends the base config, providing methods to handle request transformation, response parsing, URL construction, and error handling specific to Deepgram's API.

methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI transcription parameters supported by Deepgram.

methods.description: Maps non-default parameters to optional parameters, filtering only those supported.

methods.description: Returns a Deepgram-specific exception class based on error message and status code.

methods.name: AudioTranscriptionRequestData transform_audio_transcription_request( self, model: str, audio_file: FileTypes, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Processes the input audio file, converting it into the format required for Deepgram API requests, i.e., binary data.

methods.name: TranscriptionResponse transform_audio_transcription_response( self, raw_response: Response, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw Deepgram API response into a standardized TranscriptionResponse format, handling diarization and language detection.

methods.name: str _reconstruct_diarized_transcript(self, words: list)
methods.description: Reconstructs a diarized transcript with speaker labels from a list of word objects.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Builds the full API request URL with query parameters based on optional parameters and environment secrets.

methods.name: str _format_param_value(self, value)
methods.description: Formats parameter values into string representations suitable for URL query strings.

methods.name: dict _build_query_params(self, optional_params: dict, model: str)
methods.description: Constructs a dictionary of URL query parameters from optional settings.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
